title: Stage 08 Lean4 theorem prover contract
prompt: Ensure Stage 08 (s08_lean4_theorem_prover) theorem proving integration works. Run the proving smoke test and fix any failures. Prerequisites: lean_runner container running, OPENROUTER_API_KEY set, scillm[certainly] installed. Do not modify unrelated stages. Return JSON with keys ok, summary, artifacts.

llm_gate.prompt: You are the contract auditor for Stage 08 Lean4 Theorem Prover. Approve only if: (1) the proving smoke test passed with at least one successful proof, (2) the integration uses scillm.integrations.certainly or certainly_prove_iter. If the lean_runner container is not running or OPENROUTER_API_KEY is missing, return ok=false with clear next_actions to fix prerequisites.
